seoDescription: Learn how to extend the Payload CMS admin interface by creating a custom root view. This guide demonstrates building a public user registration page, a feature not available by default. You'll see how to modify your `payload.config.ts` to add a new route, create a custom React component for the registration form, and leverage Payload's built-in UI elements like `TextInput` and `PasswordInput`. The tutorial also covers how to call the users API endpoint to create a new user and manage basic access control.

chapters.title: Introduction to Payload CMS & Video Goal
chapters.description: A quick overview of Payload CMS and a statement of the video's objective: to build a custom user creation screen in the admin UI.

chapters.title: Project Setup and Initial State
chapters.description: A new Payload CMS project is created and the default user creation process is demonstrated to establish a baseline.

chapters.title: Configuring a Custom Root View in payload.config.ts
chapters.description: This chapter walks through modifying the payload config file to register a new custom view for the admin panel.

chapters.title: Creating the Basic View Component
chapters.description: A new React component is created using Payload's `DefaultTemplate` to serve as the foundation for the custom admin page.

chapters.title: Building the UI Form Component
chapters.description: A new client component is created for the registration form, incorporating state management and Payload's built-in UI components.

chapters.title: Finding and Using the Password Input
chapters.description: This chapter covers the challenge of finding and correctly importing the specialized `PasswordInput` component from a non-standard path.

chapters.title: Implementing the Create Account Logic
chapters.description: The form's `onClick` handler is implemented to make a `fetch` POST request to the `/api/users` endpoint to create the new user.

chapters.title: Debugging the API Call: Permissions and Headers
chapters.description: This segment focuses on troubleshooting failed API requests, identifying and fixing missing collection permissions and incorrect request headers.

chapters.title: Final Touches, Testing, and Conclusion
chapters.description: The final code is tested end-to-end, a redirect path is corrected, and the process is confirmed to work before concluding the video.
